## 1. Context and scope

The Campus Library Reservation System (CLRS) will replace the university’s ageing study-room reservation tool. It will support students and library staff across three campuses. Students must be able to search for rooms and equipment, create and manage reservations, and receive reminders. ## 1. Context and scope

The Campus Library Reservation System (CLRS) replaces the ageing study-room reservation tool used across three university libraries. Students and staff must be able to search rooms and equipment, create or change reservations, cancel reservations, and receive reminders.
